fields.label: Process name
fields.description: Private canonical process definition name used for exact duplicate review.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: Private explanation of what the process produces or verifies and why it exists.

fields.label: Trigger kinds
fields.description: Private ordered trigger kinds paired by index with objective trigger conditions.

fields.label: Trigger conditions
fields.description: Private ordered objective conditions paired by index with the governed trigger kinds.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.description: Private cadence request matched through governed aliases to one exact current schema option.

fields.label: Process logic owner
fields.description: Private exact role name resolved to one existing role resource identity.

fields.label: Step roles
fields.description: Private ordered role names paired by index with step capabilities, objectives, and work-items.

fields.label: Step capabilities
fields.description: Private ordered capability keys paired by index with exact role-bounded process steps.

fields.label: Step objectives
fields.description: Private ordered step objectives; each entry becomes one role-bounded process step.

fields.label: Work-items
fields.description: Private ordered definition-level work-items paired one-to-one with the process steps.

fields.label: Exception handling
fields.description: Optional private bounded failure-and-workaround statements for the process definition.

fields.label: Post-run summary fields
fields.description: Private ordered facts the closing step must record on each process run.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Optional private category request matched to one exact current schema option or held.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Optional private tag requests; every value must match the current normalized schema.

fields.label: Related service
fields.description: Optional private exact service name resolved to one existing service resource identity.

fields.label: Create Task records
fields.description: Records whether Task creation was requested so the definition-versus-run boundary can be shown explicitly.
